g.text: 78810 - Real Time Systems for Automation M
B5665 - Real Time Systems and Programming for Automation M
programming_basics: introductory programming constructs, control flow, procedures, recursion and exceptions.
programming_paradigms: object-oriented, functional, logical and concurrent programming paradigms.
algorithms: design and analysis of simple algorithms.
language_types: types, type checking, subtyping, inheritance and parameter mechanisms.
programming_practice: C, Python, Kotlin, debugging and programming tools.
formal_languages: regular and context-free languages, grammars, automata and pumping theorems.
syntax_parsing: BNF, lexical analysis and deterministic context-free parsing.
semantics_implementation: syntax, semantics, pragmatics, SOS, interpreters and compilers.
language_runtime: environments, scopes, activation records, heaps and memory management.
os_architecture: structure and organization of multitasking operating systems.
process_thread_management: processes, scheduling, threads and system calls.
memory_storage_io: memory, filesystems, secondary storage and I/O device management.
os_administration_security: Unix/Linux administration, shell scripting and authorization.
concurrency_models: concurrent, shared-memory, actor and message-passing models.
synchronization_coordination: semaphores, monitors, deadlocks and shared-resource protocols.
asynchronous_distributed_communication: futures, promises, event loops, reactive programming, RPC and middleware communication.
realtime_systems: real-time characteristics, periodic and aperiodic scheduling and hard real-time programming.
concurrency_verification: Petri Nets, Statecharts, safety, liveness, temporal logic and model checking.
relational_data: relational databases, relational algebra and database integration.
data_modeling: Entity-Relationship modeling and logical relational schema design.
sql_querying: SQL definition, manipulation, queries, views and database applications.
database_physical_design: indexes, B+ trees, query processing, joins and database parallelism.
transaction_recovery: transactions, concurrency control, distributed transactions and recovery.
distributed_databases: fragmentation, replication and distributed database organization.
software_lifecycle: software lifecycle phases, production and maintenance.
requirements_and_design: requirements engineering, object-oriented design, UML and software architecture.
software_quality_testing: quality assurance, certification, automated and multi-target testing.
software_configuration: version control, software versioning, build automation, continuous integration and delivery.
domain_modeling: Domain-Driven Design, domain-specific languages, model-driven design and transformations.
distributed_architectures: distributed, component-based, three-tier, Web-integrated and microservice architectures.
enterprise_frameworks: Spring, dependency injection, aspect-oriented programming and Enterprise JavaBeans.
middleware_and_services: service-oriented computing, message-oriented middleware, RPC and serverless models.
enterprise_persistence: JPA, Hibernate, object-relational mapping, queries and persistence performance.
enterprise_runtime: application servers, naming, clustering, transactions, monitoring, scalability and fault tolerance.
virtualization_and_containers: virtualization, Docker, images, Compose, container networking and orchestration.
infrastructure_automation: centralized configuration, Configuration as Code, deployment automation and cloud management.
network_systems: network configuration, routing, DNS, network administration, monitoring and troubleshooting.
identity_and_system_security: LDAP, Active Directory, Kerberos, authorization, firewalls, proxies and secure communications.
system_observability: system and distributed-service monitoring, SNMP, JMX and performance observation.
availability_and_integration: high availability, distributed filesystems, block storage, industrial protocols and heterogeneous system integration.
information_systems: classification, management, architecture and design of enterprise information systems.
process_and_data_modeling: Data-Flow Diagrams, workflow schemata and organizational process analysis.
information_systems_planning: feasibility, cost-benefit, risk, scope, ERP, CRM, application portfolios, BPR and master data management.
project_management: lifecycle, approaches, process groups, knowledge areas and project/program/portfolio management.
industrial_machine_learning: artificial intelligence and machine learning applied to industrial use cases.
optimization_and_simulation: mathematical modeling, combinatorial optimization, resource and production planning, power networks and simulation.
predictive_maintenance: time-series models, Remaining Useful Life estimation, anomaly detection and maintenance policies.
responsible_recommendation: recommendation systems, probabilistic models and fairness constraints.
user_research_and_design: user-centered design, HCI/UX, interviews, observation, personas and experience mapping.
service_prototyping: service design, journey and ecosystem maps, blueprints, prototyping and usability testing.
web_and_interactive_programming: HTML, JavaScript, Web systems, event-driven programming and user interfaces.
web_application_security: security of Web and mobile applications.
quantitative_evaluation: survey design and statistical analysis for quantitative research.
